tools.name: latest_articles
tools.description: Latest articles (notas) published on badabun.com, newest first: title, section, summary, date, URL and Markdown URL. / Las notas más recientes.

tools.name: search_articles
tools.description: Search Badabun articles (notas) by words in the title or summary (all must match). Up to 10, newest first; optional section id from list_sections. / Busca notas por tema.

tools.name: read_article
tools.description: Read one Badabun article (nota) as Markdown: full text with title, description, dates, section and author in the frontmatter. Takes the article URL (https://badabun.com/seccion/nota/). / Lee una nota completa.

tools.name: list_sections
tools.description: List the site sections with description, URL and agent index (llms.txt). / Secciones de Badabun.
